query: A cloud-smart policy will guide the use of public, private and hybrid cloud services.
Applications and infrastructure will be assessed for cloud readiness and migration suitability.
A target architecture and phased cloud adoption roadmap will be developed.
Cloud governance, service management, FinOps and provider-management roles will be established.
A government cloud centre of excellence will support agencies through adoption.
The project will support the government in preparing a cloud strategy and planning its adoption of cloud computing.
